summary: Frontend UI testing for RCC Leads CRM. Verified login page, admin login + dashboard, Users navigation, new-user dialog, Lead Entry page (/filler) with Open Instagram button, lead form submission, duplicate lead error toast, and admin sidebar logout. Phase 2 (filler login + closer end-to-end flow) was impacted by session/cookie race conditions on rapid logout→login cycles (repeated /api/auth/me 401s, navigation bouncing /admin → / → /login). Closer dashboard, tel link, StatusUpdateDialog, Follow-up/Not-Called filters could not be reliably executed end-to-end due to the session flakiness; reporting these as unverified rather than failing.

integration_issues.flow: Rapid session switching (logout -> login as different role)
integration_issues.issue: After Sign out the next /api/auth/me consistently returns 401 and the router redirects to /login mid-navigation. Suggests cookie not cleared atomically on logout, or initial /me fires before the new login's Set-Cookie is applied. Browser test had to retry and the navigation oscillated /admin -> / -> /login. Functionally, each individual login works when done fresh, but chained role-switch flows are flaky.

action_items: Main agent should manually or re-run automated tests for the closer end-to-end flow and lead-filler role, ideally starting each role in a fresh browser context to avoid the session race.

Investigate logout flow: ensure /api/auth/logout response clears the httpOnly cookie AND the frontend AuthContext clears its in-memory user before navigating to /login. Currently AuthContext may be firing /api/auth/me after a stale session state during the brief window after logout, producing 401 bounces when the next login occurs quickly.

The review_request lists wrong data-testid names (user-name-input, call-button-<id>, status-update-approved, etc.). Actual ids in code: new-user-name/email/password/role/submit. Align docs or add the additional testids as aliases. Confirm real testids used in CloserDashboard/StatusUpdateDialog/LeadForm for call/tel/status buttons and share them in the next review_request to aid automated testing.
(Minor A11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to DialogContent in UserManagementPage + StatusUpdateDialog to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend polling /api/leads every 5s + AuthContext /me check on every route change can amplify 401 spam during any brief auth gap. Consider debouncing the first /me after login or gating polling until user is hydrated.
Toast-based error surfacing for duplicates is working; ensure the toast includes the conflicting field for better UX.

rca of the issue: Login chain flakiness RCA: On logout, the server clears the httpOnly cookie, but the AuthContext on the subsequent login page navigates eagerly. The very next /api/auth/me call (fired before the new login POST completes and its Set-Cookie is honored) returns 401, triggering ProtectedRoute to redirect back to /login. Mitigation: in AuthContext, skip /me while on /login route, or gate /me on a user-present flag that's only set after successful login response.
